_about: Strings of the Knowledge health section.
health.title: Knowledge health
health.about: The engine computes these numbers (stats --json, lint, doctor, audit); the panel only shows them. Every tile is clickable: it leads to the command that works on it.
health.pick_project: Pick a project on the Bridge.
health.pick_first: Pick a project on the Bridge first
health.all_good: The project is in order — every condition is met
health.ratchet_note: Lint errors do not have to be zero: the ratchet holds the bar at what was reached. Green means «it did not get worse», not «perfect».
health.stubs_sub: a card created for a link, with no knowledge in it
health.doctor_clean: doctor found neither blockers nor warnings.
health.contents_hint: How many cards are in the base, not counting service maps and tables of contents
health.trust_why_old: why the rest are not — not computed: the project engine is older than 1.93
health.trust_hint: The share of trusted cards among those that have something to verify: stubs without knowledge and service files do not count. Trust is computed from sources and the statuses of related tasks, not assigned by a human
health.kinds_old: not measured: the project engine is older than 1.93
health.kinds_missing: {n} without a type — unknown who should edit the body
health.links_both: {orphans} cards with no links · {broken} broken links
health.errors_stuck: the repair does not take them — they await your decision
health.models_none: not checked — the link is live, it is checked by a button
health.models_hint: A live check of every backend. Done by a button: these are network requests
health.index_none: not built: search goes by words only
health.index_hint: «Not indexed» is cured by a rebuild; «stale» means that meaning-based search answers from the old text
health.retrieval_none: not checked: the order of cards changes unnoticed
health.retrieval_hint: Which cards come first for real queries and what changed
health.unfinished_sub: documents did not pass the chain · the oldest {days} days
health.unfinished_none: every started document was carried to the end
health.unfinished_hint: Production started and not finished. It continues from the same point
health.unfinished_about: The chain stopped at the named stage. It continues from the same point — nothing has to be parsed or asked again.
health.corrections_ask: in question {n}: the source was updated after the correction
health.corrections_sub: on top of the sources, applied at every build
health.corrections_about: The source changed after a human wrote the correction. Only a human sees the contradiction: read both versions and decide. Until you do, the correction stays in force — dropping something verified on suspicion means trading it for something unconfirmed.
health.left_sub: what a button does not solve
